social_circle.name: Frank Trujillo

demographics.occupation: retired; former long-day worker and practical home repairman

background.how_they_met: Frank is Iris's husband; they married when Iris was young and built their family life in Georgia.
background.why_close: They have been married for more than fifty years, live together full time, share household expenses, attend church, watch Braves games, and manage aging and health routines together.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Quiet and steady, more likely to sit beside Iris or handle a practical task than talk at length; tends to get quiet when worried.

recent_text_topics: Coordinating doctor appointments earlier in the day to avoid traffic and fatigue.
Checking grocery and meal plans that fit Frank's diabetes needs.
Planning Sunday church and errands.
Discussing Braves games, old cars, and home repairs.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05: Iris is married to Frank, has been married more than fifty years, and describes him as quiet, interested in old cars and baseball. Q11 and Q51: it is just Iris and Frank living together. Q35: Frank has diabetes and had a prior heart scare. Q55: Frank and Iris share household expenses.

social_circle.name: Paula Whitaker

demographics.education: associate degree in medical office administration

background.how_they_met: Paula is Iris and Frank's daughter, raised in their Covington-area family home.
background.why_close: They are in frequent contact, and Paula is the child Iris relies on most for medical paperwork, online health information, family updates, and emotional conversation.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in clear full sentences, often with quick practical questions, appointment reminders, and family photos. Uses a few heart and prayer emojis but keeps messages concise during work hours.

shared_activities: occasional errands near Covington and Conyers
recent_text_topics: Checking whether Iris and Frank have scheduled upcoming doctor and dental appointments.
Helping Iris compare prescription refill details and look up plain-language vaccine guidance.
Coordinating a family meal and asking which pie the grandchildren want next time they visit.
Talking about racial justice and local politics in a cautious but more open way than Iris has with many church friends.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05: Paula lives near Conyers, works in a medical office, and Iris talks to her several times a week. Q36: Paula helps Iris look over medical paperwork. Q42: Paula helps Iris look up CDC information. Q44: Iris told Paula when upset about a friend's stroke. Q29: Iris talks with Paula about race and policing.

social_circle.name: Carol Bennett

background.how_they_met: Carol is Iris's younger sister; they grew up together near Covington in the same farming family.
background.why_close: They share childhood memories, family recipes, health worries, Southern Baptist faith, and a habit of direct emotional support.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Uses short, familiar texts with full words rather than slang. Often sends recipe notes, appointment updates, and 'call me when you sit down' messages.

recent_text_topics: Comparing notes on arthritis stiffness, breathing trouble, and upcoming appointments.
Trading recipes for greens, biscuits, and lighter versions of old family dishes.

Nighttime worry check-ins when Iris feels lonely or unsettled.
